quotes.text: The boat was clean and well kept. Also, Captain Juan was very versed in how to drive a boat for wake surfing & tubing. He definitely knows what he's doing and is very comfortable in the Captains chair. We would love to rent with Austin Sun Boat Rentals again!

We rented a boat for our family on Easter Sunday, the captain, Mason was so kind and friendly. He even hid eggs around the boat for the kids to find. We had a really great experience and will definitely be returning again hopefully soon.

quotes.author: Briana Keogh
quotes.text: Austin Sun Boat Rentals was the best! the Captain made sure we were all safe and having a blast at the same time. Very fun and personable boat driver. The boat was super nice and clean. 10/10 recommend!
Hired them for my 40th bday, and let me tell you! We had so much fun, Jon was amazing with covering everything imaginable so me and my guests could have fun without worry! Can't wait to do it again!
